mapper.select: SELECT FROM formula_definition ORDER BY ${q.orderBy} LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO formula_definition (code, name, definition_type, data_type, expression, source_definition, api_path, http_method, response_path, business_description, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{definitionType}, #{dataType}, #{expression}, #{sourceDefinition}, #{apiPath}, #{httpMethod}, #{responsePath}, #{businessDescription}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE formula_definition SET name = #{name}, definition_type = #{definitionType}, data_type = #{dataType}, expression = #{expression}, source_definition = #{sourceDefinition}, api_path = #{apiPath}, http_method = #{httpMethod}, response_path = #{responsePath}, business_description = #{businessDescription}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE formula_definition SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
